translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Paulo So Barnabas Ere Ikonium Matko Urata Makoik

Masi kine kine korop Antiok wakonge, yale waka Ikonium matko wakonge. Paulo so Barnabas ere Yuda eŋane lewa lewaŋ urumgo ari ŋei ŋerep edangeik, ea wane Yuda ŋei ŋerep so qelaŋ ŋei ŋerep Yuda ŋadino eŋe loutneŋo mali malip korop okane, Yesu mogatkakoi.
Ŋo Yuda ŋei ŋerep Yesu mi mogat kakoi, eŋe qelaŋ ŋei ŋerep Yuda ŋadino malip malip magu gekoi, eŋe kimakopene ŋaba okan onikei wane wetene qepoke qebinongoi.

Aposolo ere soda loutne Ikonium ge more Woam wane ra more kaet midaine togoleka don maine edangoik. Waomŋo ere qesiŋotki so ere masi kine kine togole mauk, ea wane Waom eŋe ŋei ŋerep wetineŋo malipone more sikanonge, aposolo ere biŋek don kisi ea ra qelaŋan ongoik.
Mat welaine eŋe wet etke okangoi, ŋei ŋerep natne eŋe wiri Yuda tego mogat ongoi, ŋo ŋei ŋerep natne eŋe aposolo ere mogat otkoi.
Pakiso, ŋei qelaŋ Yuda ŋadino, so Yuda ŋei tego natne eŋe suaine kopene eŋerop aposolo matali ore more wesiŋo etkuwi seukkeik wane rau togoleke.
Rauso aposolo ere don ea dere more Listra so Derbe matko, Likaonia kepeo kaet arikoik.
Ere kepe yewao Anutu wane don kisi maine, ea ra qelaŋan ongoik.
Paulo So Barnabas Ere Listra So Derbe Matko Arikoik
Listra matko, ŋei mane kine qotkoine eŋe nabok kotino ŋine mo yaline sarike, paki eŋe numa mane mi ari geke.

Eŋe met met ka mere Paulo wane don detke, Paulo eŋe ŋei ea detlukkake, ŋei eaŋo Paulo wane don dere malip kake, ea wane Anutuŋo eŋe maine ma menaŋkayake, ea wane Paulo eŋe yale dere more ŋei kine qotkoine ea pore kalilipka,
so boka olatke, “Ge wie koboine kieŋone kutno okoranom!” Ŋei ea eŋe kaŋzage wie more kieke gesoke lolike arike.
Pakimo, Paulo eŋe masi ea maki wakongi, ŋei ŋerep eŋe ka more, enŋene Likaonian donenoka kieke boka rakoi, “Anutu eŋe ŋei yale lele more ŋenano ket sarimami!”
Ŋei ŋerep eŋe Barnabas wane anutu mane Zeus orakoi, ŋo eŋe Paulo wane anutu mane Hermes orakoi, onoka wane Heremes eŋe Zeus wane don ra qelaŋangi detkoi, ea wane.

Anutu mane, eŋetine Zeus, eŋane matine mat suaine ŋadino pake. Zeus wane mosop ŋei eŋine so ŋei ŋerep eŋe aposolo erano bulamakau ŋei so zariŋ peike, mat wane madetko ma sarikoi, eŋe so ŋei ŋerep magu eŋe aposolo bakom okan otkei wane.

Pakimo Barnabas so Paulo ere ŋei ŋerep eŋe daleo okangei wane okangoi, ea wane similene detluke more, ma waulukonikeik wane, takot lap lap etne ma barake more, biririke ari ŋei ŋerep magu keueno boka ari rakoik.

“Onoka wane kine kine iwa mamami? Ŋere kepe ŋeika, ŋere ŋine yaleka! Ŋere ŋine don kisi maine, ea ŋidaniketane sarimaite, ŋine anutu isisine ea ŋadekka more, zinge Anutu gege welaine eŋane kaitko gekei. Anutu gege welaine eŋe qeli so kepe so kine kine korop ma wakonge.
Mo sogino Anutuŋo ŋei ŋerep qeliŋongi yau yaup gekoi,

ŋo naso baŋem eŋe eŋine kine ŋei ŋerep sikanonge, ea wane eŋe masi weku mane ma mageake, eŋe koya qeliwo ŋine maki ket okanmaike, eŋe eki zaguk maki wele qe okanmami, eŋe ŋara ŋibon okanmaike, so koto ŋino wet peseŋo qe watkemaike, eŋe ŋinane bakomŋine kito okanmaike.”
Paki ere don ea edankoik, ŋo ere ŋei ŋerep eŋe rawetonbik erane bakom kito soe soep mi maikei wane urata suaine makoik.

Pakiso, Yuda ŋei natne, Antiok matko Pisidia kepeo ŋine, so natne Ikonium ŋine, eŋe ŋei ŋerep magu ea ebuwi, eŋe Paulo wesiŋo qeu paki, waraŋka ma ket mat ŋadino birakau paki, rakoi Paulo mo seukmaike.
Ŋo, malip malip magu eŋe Paulo wano lewageu paki lolikka okorakoi, Paulo eŋe koso wie more mat koto waketke, kepe qaeki eŋe so Barnabas ere Derbe matko arikoik.
Barnabas So Paulo Ere Antiok, Siria Kepe Zinge Arikoik

Paulo so Barnabas ere don kisi maine ea Derbe matko ra qelaŋanbik ea wane ŋei ŋerep loutne eŋe Waom mogat kakoi, pakiso ere zinge Listra matko ari more, ea ŋine, Ikonium so Antiok matko, Pisidia kepeo lolike arikoik.

Ere mali malip magu zonom ebongoik, so mali malip wele eao kito gekei wane, dokoetne mat ea korop ma togole edangoik. Ma togole one rakoik, “Ŋine Waomze koboboine mogat kaikei, ŋene Anutu wane gege kepeo wakesikene ea wane ŋene kepe iwao umat wikile loutne desikene.”

Ere malip malip maguine maguine eŋano ari more, sawe ge meŋenka more ware ware maguine maguine doku tau tau magu eŋane biraongoik, yale waka Aposolo ere ŋei ŋerep ea mali malip korop doku tau tau Waomzane meteo biraongoik.
Ere Pisidia kepe korop lolike ari more sari Pampilia kepeo lotkekoik.
Ere Perga matko miti don ra qelaŋane more Atalia matko ari ketkoik.

Eso yewa ŋine eŋe seki kutno wa more, kito zinge Antiok matko, Siria kepeo arikoik, kepe yewao ere alakan doku tau tau magu edo ere Anutu wane metino bira ore more, mosop ore wareotpi urata ea maikeik wane meŋen kakoi. Wane yekuat namo urata ea mo mauk qoeki, ere zinge arikoik.

Ere Antiok matko lotke more mali malip magu qeturaŋ one more, Anutuŋo yeye kine kine erano maki wakonge, ea wane don kisi korop edangoik, so Anutuŋo qelaŋ ŋei ŋerep Yuda ŋadino gekoi, eŋe Anutu malipkakoi, wane eŋane numa lalaŋge, ea wane ere korop edangoik.
Ere naso kiroine mali malip ŋei ŋerep eŋerop ea metkoik.
